title: Crashes if a student has no marks yet
plain: A new function works out the class average. If a student has an empty marks list, dividing by zero crashes the program. A new student would have no marks.
diff:
--- a/marks.py
+++ b/marks.py
@@ -18,6 +18,11 @@
     return total / count
 
 
+def average_of_list(marks):
+    """Return the average of a list of marks."""
+    return sum(marks) / len(marks)
+
+
